title: Gina connectors.json
description: Database and service connector declarations for a Gina bundle. Each key is a logical connector name; the value describes the connection parameters. Acquired at runtime via getConnection(). The required fields depend on the connector type.

connector.description: Connector driver type. Required when the key name does not match a built-in connector name (e.g. key "session" with connector "redis").

version.description: Optional semver range for the driver npm package. Used by `connector:list` to flag cross-bundle version-pin disagreements and by `connector:add` to print the exact install command. When omitted, the framework falls back to the project's package.json dependency range, then to the framework's built-in driver range table.

protocol.description: Connection protocol URI scheme. Required for Couchbase and AI connectors.

host.description: Hostname or IP address. Supports comma-separated values for clusters and ${variable} interpolation. Required for Couchbase, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis.

port.description: Server port. Defaults: MySQL 3306, PostgreSQL 5432, Redis 6379.

database.description: Database, bucket, or keyspace name. Also used as the model directory name under models/. Required for Couchbase, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, ScyllaDB, DuckDB.

contactPoints.description: ScyllaDB / Cassandra only. Cluster contact points. Accepts an array of `host:port` strings, a comma-separated string, or falls back to the `host`+`port` pair when omitted. Defaults to ["127.0.0.1:9042"].

localDataCenter.description: ScyllaDB / Cassandra only. Data center name used for token-aware routing. Required by cassandra-driver 4.x. Defaults to "datacenter1".

keyspace.description: ScyllaDB / Cassandra only. CQL keyspace name. Alias for `database` when both are supported; `keyspace` wins when both are set.

credentials.description: ScyllaDB / Cassandra only. Authentication credentials. Use this OR the legacy `username`+`password` pair.

password.description: Authentication password. Supports ${variable} interpolation for secrets.

scope.description: Data isolation scope stamped on every document at insert time and used to filter queries. Falls back to NODE_SCOPE env var when omitted.

connectionLimit.description: Maximum connections in the pool. MySQL and PostgreSQL only. Defaults to 10.

ssl.description: TLS/SSL configuration. Passed through to the underlying driver (mysql2, pg). Set to true for default TLS.

file.description: SQLite and DuckDB only. Database file path. Defaults to ~/.gina/{database}.sqlite (SQLite) or ~/.gina/{database}.duckdb (DuckDB). Use ":memory:" for in-memory databases.

readOnly.description: DuckDB only. Open the database in read-only mode (driver access_mode READ_ONLY). The engine refuses writes, and any number of read-only processes can share one file — while a read-write process holds a DuckDB file, no other process can open it at all. Defaults to false.

idleTimeout.description: PostgreSQL only. Idle client timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

connectionTimeout.description: PostgreSQL only. Connection timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 2000.

db.description: Redis only. Database index (0-15). Defaults to 0.

tls.description: Redis only. Enable TLS for the connection.

prefix.description: Redis and SQLite session stores. Key prefix for session store entries. Defaults to "sess:". The Couchbase stores read `prefix` as a constructor option only, never from this file.

ttl.description: Redis, SQLite, MongoDB and ScyllaDB session stores. Default TTL in seconds for session entries. When omitted, the session record follows the cookie's `maxAge`, falling back to 86400 only when the cookie has none. Must be a positive number of seconds — a non-positive value (including 0) is refused at bundle init. The Couchbase stores read `ttl` as a constructor option only, never from this file.

cluster.description: Redis Cluster only. Array of cluster node endpoints.

keepAlive.description: Couchbase only. Enable TCP keep-alive. Defaults to true.

pingInterval.description: Couchbase only. Interval to keep the connection alive (e.g. "2m", "30s").

readyTimeout.description: Couchbase only. Milliseconds to wait for the connector to become ready at boot before it reports the failure and the bundle exits. Defaults to 50000. A non-positive or non-numeric value falls back to the default. Values at or above the CLI's bundle-start budget (~64s) cannot take effect, because the CLI terminates the bundle first.

useScopeAndCollections.description: Couchbase only. Accepted but currently inert — the connector partitions data via _scope/_collection document fields (one bucket, default collection); named-collection KV access is available per call via entity.getConnection(scope, collection). Reserved for a possible future native scope/collection routing mode.

timeouts.description: Couchbase only. Timeout overrides passed to the SDK.

detailed_errcodes.description: Couchbase only. Expose detailed error codes instead of generic messages.

apiKey.description: AI connector only. API key for the provider. Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation.

model.description: AI connector only. Default model identifier.

baseURL.description: AI connector only. Override the default API base URL (OpenAI-compatible providers).

uri.description: MongoDB only. Full connection string (mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://). Takes precedence over the decomposed host/port/username/password/authSource/replicaSet fields. The `database` field is still required and is used to select the db on the client.

authSource.description: MongoDB only. Authentication database name (typically "admin"). Used when `uri` is absent and the username/password live under a different db than the one you're querying.

replicaSet.description: MongoDB only. Replica set name. Used when `uri` is absent and you connect to a replica-set deployment.
